means: For every scored T-spin in the corpus (a T with an engine spin credit that cleared lines, inside the verified prefix, passing the reconstruction check), whether the 途中DT砲 page's local shape stood around it: the lock's cells are the page's flat T pointing down (as drawn, or mirrored) and every cell of the window around it — the wall column, the TST slot over the T's middle with its overhang above, the two rows the TSD clears and the TST slot's bottom cell under the nub — is filled or empty as drawn. The opportunity is a full T-spin Double; every hit is followed to the next T lock to see whether the TST the page draws next fired.
not_eligible_because: simulator output: which local shape a T went into is read off the vendored Triangle engine's boards, and nothing on the corpus side has a second implementation of it. No claim id, no badge, no figure in a report.
caveat: garbage is read as FILLED inside the window, and its hole columns are the engine's seeded-RNG columns, which disagree with the recorded ones (oracle-source.ts); a hit with garbage in its window is named in garbage_in_window for that reason. At a full TSD the two cleared rows are entailed by the clear (NaiveClauseForced): the T's orientation and the rows above and below them discriminate. DT Cannon is also an opener; a hit inside the opener window is counted as in_opener, not dropped. Counts only, always N / M with the denominator.
rules: opportunity: a T lock with spin "full" clearing 2 lines, at a 0-based lock index <= the verified index, whose board-before plus its cells makes exactly the rows the engine recorded clearing (the reconstruction check, counted exactly as opener-facts.json donation.check counts it)

match: the lock's cells equal the variant's flat T under one translation (mirrored: columns reflected in the window), and every other window cell is filled (a piece or garbage) or empty as the page draws it; colour is never compared; cells outside the window are not read
mirrored is tried only when as-drawn fails; a window leaving the board is no match (window_off_board)

follow-up: the page's TST slot (the stood T over the TSD's middle, nub toward the wall, its bottom cell under the TSD's nub, split by the two cleared rows until the TSD joins it) carried through every clear and garbage insertion to the next T lock, each step verified against the engine's next board; fired iff that T is the slot and a scored full TST
controls: the same window at scored TSS, TST, mini TSS and mini TSD; ablations no_must_empty, no_roof and t_overlap at the opportunity; orientation_baseline = opportunities whose T stands up
window_rule: 0-based lock index <= 21 is in_opener (emit-opener-facts.ts's convention; emit-attack-facts.ts counts from 1)

rules: fragment: a key cell — the overhang over the TST stem, the one window cell every build of the shape places as a piece (which piece depends on the build) — belongs to a piece not all four of whose cells are on the board before the T (a line clear cut it)
garbage_in_shape: a key cell is garbage
shape_cell_empty: a key cell is empty (the window requires it filled, so only a weakened window can admit this)
dpc: the board is empty after one of the 14 locks before the T, the T itself, or one of the 14 after it (the DPC setup)
ownership_unverified: a lock before the T has a row map the digest could not verify, so its pieces cannot be told apart
qualifies iff none applies; the shape stood at every hit either way
